title: An entry that can never succeed stops living forever
outcome: Persisting the queue removed the only way out a doomed entry had — closing the app. This puts an equivalent back, without inventing a discard the recorder cannot see.
acceptanceCriteria: An entry whose last failure was retryable never expires, however long it has been waiting. A week-long tournament with no signal keeps every rally.
An entry whose last failure was one that retrying cannot fix is dropped once it is older than seven days, and the threshold is stated in one place rather than inlined.
An entry that has never failed never expires.
Expiry is applied when the queue is read, not on a timer, so it costs nothing while the app runs.
The retryability judgement reuses the same predicate as the flush and the restore, so all three cannot disagree.
